items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I don't remember that name, Mr. Bell.

ctx.x: Yeah, on Chapitula's. Not on Napoleon. Not on Napoleon, uh-huh. No, you see. So I never didn't, I don't remember that name there. I don't remember that name, Mr. Bell.
I remember someplace, I'll look it up in my notes.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Mr. Bell is addressed by the interviewee as a form of address or filler ('He really was good, Mr. Bell', 'That's hard, Mr. Bell') throughout the monologue, but no personal relationship or interaction with Mr. Bell is described.

ctx.x: Who were the best second trumpets around town would you say in those days?

Well I'll tell you. For me, for me second trumpet player, Buddy Petey. Yeah, he's the best. Really good. Because every brass band, every brass band used to always have him to play second croquet. He used to tell me that all the time, you know. One day me and him was sitting down, you know. When I lived, I lived around for a rest of the day. And I asked him, I said, I said, what do you play?
